description: This file manages local data storage for an application, including saving app state, elements, images, and files to localStorage and IndexedDB. It defines classes for file management and data persistence, including handling obsolete files, saving data with debounce, and migrating library data from localStorage to IndexedDB.

classes.name: LocalFileManager
classes.description: Manages local file storage, including clearing obsolete files based on last retrieval time.

methods.name: saveDataStateToLocalStorage
methods.description: Saves the current elements and app state to localStorage, handling quota errors.

methods.name: isQuotaExceededError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a quota exceeded error.
